hedges.reason: HYPE is the reference asset for perp-DEX tokens. New perp venues get valued against its fee multiple, and on-chain perp volume and speculative flow show up in it first. A perp-DEX boom strong enough to send Ostium's day-after FDV above $1B should also push HYPE up to its nearer upside rungs before year-end.

Pacifica is a peer perp-DEX whose token has not launched yet, on the same kind of day-after FDV ladder. Its launch valuation depends on the same things as Ostium's: peer multiples, airdrop float, and how much capital the category is attracting. A window in which a new perp venue can price at a rich FDV would lift Pacifica's rungs as well.

BNB reflects Binance-driven speculative flow and new-listing activity. A low-float launch with day-one tier-1 listings, which is how Ostium would clear $1B, is most likely in a broad altcoin risk-on phase, when exchange tokens also rally.

claims.reason: C8 YES means Ostium launched by Dec 31 and was valued above $1B the next day. For a mid-sized Arbitrum RWA-perp venue to get there, the market has to be paying rich multiples for perp-DEX fee streams, and Hyperliquid is the anchor for those multiples. It is hard to see Ostium clearing $1B while HYPE fails even a mild upside move over the same months. A launch like that is also most likely to be scheduled into a strong-sector window.
